project.name: DecOps
project.project_type: Internal company task and workflow management system
project.objective: Replace spreadsheet-based task tracking with a centralized, secure, auditable system for managing tasks, projects, departments, responsibilities, milestones, dependencies, progress, and reporting.
product_principles: Management visibility without compromising restricted task data
Maintainable architecture with room for future expansion
non_goals: Providing unrestricted access to every employee
Automatically changing task permissions based solely on frontend state

frontend.version_policy: Use a currently supported stable release and pin the version.

backend.database_migrations: Alembic or another explicitly selected migration mechanism

row_level_security.enabled: Optional defense-in-depth after the authorization model is established.
row_level_security.policy: If enabled, configure and test PostgreSQL RLS carefully for the application database role, transaction-scoped context, connection pooling, and background workers.
row_level_security.warning: Do not treat RLS as a substitute for application authorization. Avoid privileged database credentials that silently bypass intended policies.

file_storage.purpose: Store task attachments and related documents.
requirements: Short-lived authorized download links or an authenticated download endpoint
Access checks before upload, download, replacement, or deletion

authentication.recommended_approach: Server-managed sessions using secure, HttpOnly cookies, or an approved organizational identity provider.
requirements: Secure password hashing if passwords are locally managed
Multi-factor authentication if required by Interdec

deployment.architecture: One frontend application, one API application, PostgreSQL, private file storage, and a background worker where required.

functional_modules.name: Users, Departments, and Roles
features: Support employees belonging to multiple departments if approved
Transfer task responsibilities during employee departure

functional_modules.name: Task Management
features: Complete, cancel, reopen, or archive tasks according to permissions
ui_wireframes: Kanban Board: visualize tasks by status with drag-and-drop transitions
Task Detail Modal: open from Kanban cards to show full task details

functional_modules.name: Workflow and Milestones
features: Create milestones and subtasks within stages
ui_wireframes: Gantt Chart: timeline view of stages, milestones, and dependencies
Task Detail Modal: open from Gantt bars to show workflow details

functional_modules.name: Collaboration and Notifications
ui_wireframes: Task Detail Modal: tabs for Comments, Attachments, History, Notifications

functional_modules.name: Dashboards and Reporting
ui_wireframes: Dashboard toggle: switch between Kanban and Gantt views

design_principles: Use resource-level authorization for individual tasks and their nested resources.
Do not assume that a user can access a task merely because the user knows its identifier.
Do not assume department membership automatically grants task access.
Allow permissions to vary by task when authorized.
Define explicit policies for administrative access to restricted tasks.

roles.name: System Administrator
roles.description: Maintains application infrastructure and system configuration.
permissions: Access security audit information according to policy
roles.restriction: Technical administration must not automatically imply unrestricted access to confidential business content.

roles.name: Company Administrator
roles.description: Manages Interdec users, departments, roles, and approved operational settings.

roles.name: Management
roles.description: Oversees organizational work and authorized management reporting.
roles.restriction: Organization-wide reporting must not expose restricted task content or leak confidential task existence through aggregates.

roles.name: Accountable PM
roles.description: Owns the outcome of an assigned task.

roles.name: Supporting PM
roles.description: Contributes to a task under the accountable PM.

roles.name: Department Lead
permissions: View tasks authorized for the department

roles.name: Approver
roles.description: Reviews tasks or milestones requiring formal approval.
permissions: View items submitted for review within granted scope

roles.name: Read-Only Auditor
roles.description: Reviews authorized records and audit trails.
roles.restriction: No task modification unless separately granted.

roles_and_permissions.implementation_note: Treat these roles as proposed defaults. Interdec must approve the final role matrix before production.

modes.name: private
modes.description: Access is limited to explicitly authorized users and permitted administrators.

modes.name: participants
modes.description: Access is limited to the task's authorized participants and explicitly granted reviewers.

modes.name: department_scoped
modes.description: Access is limited to users with the required department permission, subject to explicit restrictions and grants.

modes.name: custom
modes.description: Access is determined by individually granted users, groups, or approved roles.

rules: Every task has an explicit access policy.
Task creation must establish a valid access policy.
Access to a task does not automatically grant access to unrelated tasks.
Access to a task must not automatically authorize every operation on it.
Nested resources inherit task restrictions unless a more restrictive policy applies.
Changing visibility requires explicit permission and produces an audit event.
Revoked access must take effect immediately for subsequent authorization checks.
Notifications and background jobs must respect current access permissions.
Search, autocomplete, exports, dashboards, and reporting must apply authorization.
Access grants must support revocation and audit history.

transition_rules: Every transition must be validated by the backend.
Only authorized users may initiate a transition.
Completion may require all mandatory work items to be complete.
Reopening a completed task requires explicit permission and a recorded reason.
Cancelling a task requires an authorized actor and a recorded reason.
Blocked tasks must have an explanation.
Review rejection must record the reason and return the task to an actionable state.
Terminal-state and reopening rules must be confirmed with Interdec.

requirements: A task can contain multiple stages.
A stage can contain milestones and subtasks.
Work items can be assigned to individual employees.
Work items can have independent start dates and deadlines.
Dependencies can connect work items within or across stages.
Sequential stages become actionable according to predecessor completion.
Mandatory and optional milestones must be distinguishable.
Completed work items retain their completion history.

execution_modes.sequential: A stage becomes actionable when its required predecessor stages are complete.
execution_modes.parallel: Multiple stages can remain active simultaneously, subject to dependencies.
execution_modes.mixed: A workflow can combine sequential and parallel stages.

progress_calculation.default: Calculate progress from required work items and configured stage weights.
requirements: Define whether milestones or subtasks contribute to progress.
Avoid counting the same work twice when calculating parent progress.
Define how cancelled and optional items affect progress.
Distinguish calculated progress from manually entered progress.
Record manual overrides and reasons if overrides are permitted.
Display the calculation method to authorized users.

conventions.primary_keys: Use UUIDs or another consistently generated, non-guessable identifier strategy.
conventions.timestamps: Store timestamps in UTC and render them in the configured user or company timezone.
conventions.soft_deletion: Use explicit lifecycle and archival rules rather than silently deleting operational records.
conventions.audit: Record actor, action, resource, timestamp, and relevant before-and-after values where appropriate.
conventions.authorization: Every protected resource must be authorized independently on the backend.

database_constraints: Enforce unique employee codes where used.
Prevent duplicate active task assignments where applicable.
Prevent duplicate access grants where prohibited.
Use optimistic concurrency checks on editable tasks and work items.
Index task assignments, departments, statuses, due dates, and audit lookups.

principles: Keep business logic out of route handlers.
Validate all imported and external data.
Use background workers for asynchronous tasks.
Avoid introducing microservices before there is a demonstrated need.
request_authorization_pipeline: Confirm that the account and session are active.
Resolve the requested operation and resource.
Check access to the specific task or resource.
Check the user's task-level role and permitted action.
Write relevant notification events to the transactional outbox.
Return only fields the user is authorized to receive.
consistency_requirements: Business changes, audit events, and outbox events should be committed atomically where feasible.
Background jobs must re-check authorization when acting on protected resources.
Notification workers must avoid sending content to users whose access has been revoked.
Concurrent edits must not silently overwrite one another.

conventions: Use consistent JSON request and response schemas.
Apply authorization before returning resource details.
Support filtering and sorting through explicit parameters.
Use idempotency keys for applicable retryable operations.
Avoid leaking restricted resource existence through error differences.

import_pipeline: Validate the file type, size, encoding, and header structure.
Allow authorized users to map source columns to DecOps fields.
Preview a sample of normalized rows.
Normalize whitespace, dates, status values, and priority values.
Resolve employee names against the user directory.
Flag ambiguous employee names for manual resolution.
Validate required fields and date relationships.
Detect likely duplicate tasks using legacy identifiers and configurable matching rules.
Allow the user to correct errors or exclude explicitly selected rows.
Commit valid rows in a transaction or controlled batch process.
Record the import job and the resulting task identifiers.
rules: Never invent a user mapping when names are ambiguous.
Do not allow an import to grant unauthorized access.
Treat legacy attachment links as untrusted references.
Do not fetch arbitrary external URLs automatically.
Do not fabricate historical audit events that cannot be verified.
Record the import actor and timestamp.
Support safe retries without duplicating previously committed records.

legacy_data_policy.historical_timestamps: Preserve source timestamps only when their meaning and reliability are understood.
legacy_data_policy.historical_progress: Import the supplied percentage but flag records requiring reconciliation with the new workflow calculation.
legacy_data_policy.legacy_statuses: Use an approved mapping table and report unmapped values.
legacy_data_policy.legacy_access: Assign an explicitly approved initial visibility policy to imported tasks.
legacy_data_policy.legacy_dependencies: Preserve the original dependency description even when the referenced task cannot be resolved.

frontend_pages.name: Calendar and Timeline
features: Filtering by authorized department or assignee

delivery_requirements: Use a transactional outbox for reliable asynchronous delivery.
Re-check authorization before sending sensitive task details.
Avoid exposing confidential task titles in email subjects where policy prohibits it.
Do not send notifications for transactions that ultimately roll back.

requirements.name: Authorization
controls: Permission checks on search and reporting

requirements.name: Cross-Task Isolation
controls: Reject unauthorized access to another task by identifier
Prevent unauthorized task counts and search suggestions

requirements.name: Auditability
controls: Exclude passwords, session tokens, and unnecessary sensitive content from logs

requirements.name: Input and File Security
controls: Protection against CSV formula injection in generated exports

mandatory_test_scenarios: User A cannot read a restricted task belonging to User B.
User A cannot update a restricted task by changing its identifier.
User A cannot retrieve another task's comments.
User A cannot download another task's attachments.
User A cannot change task visibility without permission.
User A cannot assign unauthorized users to a task.
User A cannot use search to discover restricted task titles.
User A cannot infer restricted task information through dashboard aggregates.
A revoked user loses access to subsequent requests.
A background notification job does not disclose information after access revocation.
A department member does not automatically gain access to every task associated with that department unless policy explicitly grants it.
An unauthorized export request is rejected.
Concurrent edits do not silently overwrite newer task data.

end_to_end_tests: Create a task and assign an accountable PM.
Add supporting PMs and participating departments.
Complete and reopen a task under the appropriate permissions.
Import a CSV and reconcile the results.
testing_strategy.release_gate: No unresolved critical security vulnerabilities, no known cross-task authorization failures, and no unresolved critical data-integrity defects.

implementation_phases.name: Requirements Validation
objectives: Confirm the meaning of every existing column.
Agree on role and visibility rules.
exit_criteria: Interdec approves the requirements.
Critical workflow and authorization decisions are documented.

implementation_phases.name: Application Foundation
objectives: Create application logging and error handling.
Set up automated testing and deployment environments.
exit_criteria: Users can authenticate securely.
Automated tests run in CI.
Database migrations work reliably.

implementation_phases.name: Identity and Authorization
exit_criteria: Cross-task isolation tests pass.
Permission changes are audited.

implementation_phases.name: Task Management
objectives: Implement task detail and register interfaces.
exit_criteria: Users can manage authorized tasks.
All task mutations enforce authorization and validation.

implementation_phases.name: Workflow Engine
exit_criteria: Required workflows pass end-to-end tests.
Invalid transitions and dependency cycles are rejected.

implementation_phases.name: Collaboration and Notifications
exit_criteria: Restricted content remains protected across collaboration features.
Notification processing is retry-safe.

implementation_phases.name: Dashboards and Reporting
exit_criteria: Dashboard totals reconcile with authorized task records.
Restricted information does not leak through reports.

implementation_phases.name: CSV Migration
exit_criteria: Interdec approves the migrated data.
Failed and ambiguous rows are explicitly reported.

implementation_phases.name: Hardening and User Acceptance Testing
exit_criteria: Interdec approves the application for production.
Critical security and data-integrity issues are resolved.

implementation_phases.name: Production Launch
exit_criteria: Authorized users can perform their required workflows.
Monitoring, backup, and recovery processes are operational.
Interdec accepts the production rollout.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: An authorized user can create a task with a unique task number, title, description, priority, accountable PM, and due date.
Every active task has exactly one accountable PM unless Interdec explicitly approves a different accountability model.
A task can have multiple supporting PMs and participating departments.
A task can contain multiple stages, milestones, and subtasks.
Sequential, parallel, and mixed workflows behave according to configured rules.
Task progress is calculated consistently and the calculation method is visible to authorized users.
Authorized users can report blockers and update their resolution status.
Task dependencies are validated and circular dependencies are rejected.
Task visibility can be configured according to the approved access policy.
A user cannot access an unauthorized task by guessing, changing, or reusing a resource identifier.
Task isolation applies to comments, attachments, work items, search, exports, and dashboards.
Task creation, assignments, visibility changes, status changes, and administrative changes generate appropriate audit events.
Authorized users receive relevant notifications without exposing restricted task information.
Dashboards and reports include only information the requesting user is authorized to access.
CSV import supports column mapping, preview, validation, duplicate detection, and row-level error reporting.
Ambiguous employee mappings and invalid dates are flagged instead of silently guessed.
Task attachments are private and every download is authorized.
Concurrent updates cannot silently overwrite a more recent task version.
Production data can be restored from backups using a tested recovery procedure.
Interdec completes user acceptance testing and approves the production rollout.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: Can a task have more than one accountable PM?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: One accountable PM with multiple supporting PMs.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: Does department membership automatically grant access to department tasks?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: Only when explicitly permitted by the task's access policy.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: Who can create, change, and revoke task visibility grants?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: Authorized task owners and designated administrators, with audit logging.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: Can task workflows contain sequential and parallel stages?
Must all milestones be complete before a task can be completed?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: All required milestones must be complete.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: Is formal approval required before task completion?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: Make approval configurable per task or workflow template.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: Who can reopen completed or cancelled tasks?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: Authorized users with a recorded reason.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: What happens when an employee leaves Interdec?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: Deactivate the account, revoke sessions, preserve history, and transfer active responsibilities through an audited process.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: Should task progress be automatically calculated or manually entered?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: Calculated progress by default, with an explicitly labeled and audited override if required.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: Which timezone should dates use?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: Store timestamps in UTC and use an agreed company timezone for date-based deadlines.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: Should DecOps use Interdec's existing identity provider?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: Use approved organizational SSO if available and suitable.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: Are email notifications required?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: Start with in-app notifications and add email if approved.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: Where should DecOps be hosted?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.recommended_default: Select hosting based on Interdec's security, availability, budget, data residency, and operational requirements.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: What are the expected user count, task volume, and attachment volume?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.purpose: Use these figures to size the deployment and establish performance targets.

decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.question: How long must completed tasks, attachments, and audit records be retained?
decisions_to_confirm_with_interdec.purpose: Establish retention, archival, and deletion policies.

definition_of_done: The approved requirements have been implemented.
The task lifecycle and workflow engine pass automated tests.
Task-level access control is enforced by the backend.
Cross-task and nested-resource isolation tests pass.
Audit events are generated for sensitive operations.
Notifications and background processing are retry-safe.
CSV imports have validation, error reporting, and reconciliation.
Production backups and restoration have been tested.
Monitoring and error reporting are operational.
Deployment and rollback procedures are documented.
User and administrator documentation is available.
Interdec has completed user acceptance testing.
